## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Singleton conformal set supports InSitu [F1], but this surgical frozen section flags all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Invasive 5%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%) | Strong InSitu call; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% target (test coverage 90%, CI 76%–98%) | Single class; meets 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, OOD 1.0, 12/12 tiles, JPEG level 3 [F6] | Reliable input despite atypical OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; nearest BACH_0391 is Invasive (0.751) | Mostly InSitu, but nearest is Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · Strongest shift away from invasion (-0.72) [F2]; 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 9) · context · Above-typical infiltrate (-0.37) is descriptive only [F3]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score shifts toward invasion (+0.34, direction down) [F4]; 0/20 check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-average stroma shifts toward invasion (+0.34, direction down); 20/20 check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (1.78) shifts toward invasion (+0.33); 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001 vs random, CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); case uses Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in high-risk regions 5 (97%), 9 (96%), or 10 (89%), matching nearest case BACH_0391 (Invasive).
- Simulated frozen-section and level-3 JPEG artifacts mask invasion or falsely trigger all-margin positivity (stains blocked).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 10**: Highest invasive risk (97%, 96%, 89%); rule out focal stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 5**: Strongest duct-confined scores; confirm atypical cells stay strictly intraductal.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Perimeter tiles; verify flagged superior, inferior, medial, and lateral margins (108–215 um).
